entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. Your return policy is a complete joke and I'm not waiting any longer to get this sorted.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's not faulty, I just don't want it! It was a gift and I'm not going to use it. I want my money back. I have the order number right here.

I understand. Could you please provide that order number for me? ... Thank you. Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. For that specific product, we have a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns.

TEN DAYS?! ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! That is absolutely unacceptable! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is ridiculous and I'm going to leave reviews everywhere about this. I've been dealing with a family emergency!
Sir, I can assure you there's no need for a manager, I'm authorized to handle this. I'm very sorry, I wasn't aware of your situation. Could you tell me what happened?

What happened is my son's military deployment got moved up suddenly, and in the middle of that chaos my husband had an accident and needed emergency surgery. He's been in the hospital for the last two weeks! The last thing on my mind was your 10-day return policy!

Oh my, I am so incredibly sorry to hear that. That sounds like an extremely stressful time for you and your family. Please, disregard what I said about the standard policy. A situation involving a hospital stay and a sudden military deployment is exactly the kind of thing we make exceptions for.
So... you're saying you'll actually take it back then?

Yes, absolutely. Given the emergency surgery and the unexpected deployment, I can process a one-time exception for you right now. I will authorize a full refund back to the original payment method. Would that be acceptable?
Oh. Well... yes. A full refund would be fine. Thank you. I... I appreciate you listening.

Of course. We're not here to make difficult times even harder. I'm sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on file now. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. The refund will be processed as soon as it's received back at our warehouse.
Okay, I see the email. Thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. I truly hope your husband has a swift recovery and your son stays safe on his deployment. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and please have a better day.
